steps: Open Google Cloud Console > Billing > Reports.
Filter Service = Identity Platform (Firebase Auth bills there once over the free tier).
If no line exists, Firebase Auth is within the free tier.
FCM is free; no billing line exists.
Confirm in Firebase Console > Project settings > Usage and billing that no FCM charge appears.

source.reason: FCM is a free product; Google publishes no billing line or usage API for it.
